title: Beachwalk 10B
meta_description: Beachwalk 10B by AvantStay---cozy PCB condo just steps from the beach with pool, grill, and space for up to 8.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Beachwalk 10B by AvantStay, a laid-back Panama City Beach retreat designed for easy coastal living, sunshine-filled days, and time well spent together.

Located just across the street from the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, this condo places you moments from the beach while keeping you close to some of the area's most popular attractions. Spend your days lounging along the shoreline, exploring Pier Park's shops and dining, or heading out for family-friendly fun at Gulf World and nearby coastal parks. With quick access to dining, entertainment, and scenic beach access, everything you love about Panama City Beach is right at your fingertips.

Inside, the home features a bright, open-concept layout that makes gathering effortless. The living room offers generous seating and a large TV---perfect for movie nights or relaxing after a day in the sun. The full kitchen is stocked with all the essentials for home-cooked meals, and the dining table seats six for shared breakfasts, seafood dinners, or game nights. Added conveniences like in-home laundry make longer stays comfortable and stress-free.

Step outside to enjoy the Florida air with outdoor seating and a grill---ideal for casual cookouts after beach days. Guests also have access to Beachwalk Condominiums community amenities, including a community pool and shuffleboard courts, offering even more ways to unwind or stay active during your stay.

Beachwalk 10B comfortably sleeps up to eight guests across two bedrooms and flexible sleeping options. The primary bedroom features a king bed, while the second bedroom offers a queen bed with easy access to a shared full bath. Additional sleeping space includes a queen Murphy bed and a queen sleeper sofa in the living room---perfect for families or groups.

Whether you're here for beach days, poolside lounging, or exploring Panama City Beach, Beachwalk 10B offers a relaxed home base in a prime coastal location.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

Panama City Beach delivers a classic Gulf Coast escape with a laid-back, sun-soaked energy that keeps guests coming back year after year. Known for its sugar-white sand and clear emerald waters, this beachfront destination blends easygoing coastal living with plenty of ways to stay entertained---from waterfront dining and family-friendly attractions to vibrant nightlife and outdoor adventures. Days are naturally spent on the beach, boating, or exploring the shoreline, while evenings invite sunset strolls, fresh seafood, and casual fun just minutes from the sand. It's a market that appeals effortlessly to families, couples, and groups looking for a seamless mix of relaxation and activity in a warm, welcoming setting.

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Pier Park, Russell-Fields Pier, Gulf World Marine Park, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Shell Island, Conservation Park, Ripley's Believe It or Not!, ZooWorld Zoological Park, Frank Brown Sports Complex, Dolly Parton's Pirate Voyage Dinner \& Show

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets (under 30 lbs) for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- The beach access is approximately 0.5 miles walking distance through a gated beachwalk access that leads to beach access 72 (runs through the Wendwood Condominiums) that is located on Front Beach Road.
- Please note your home comes equipped with a pack'and'play.

Parking Details:
- On-site parking is limited to 1 vehicle. One reserved, numbered space (10B) is located directly in front of the condo, with additional visitor parking spots available nearby.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
